phase: BNR Quarterly Financial Accounts S13 Source Screening
purpose: Classify the indexed BNR quarterly financial-accounts publication for general government (S13) against the frozen RMD sectoral-financial-position boundary, after terminal-stage audit identified it as a distinct national quarterly dissemination path.

official_source.title: Conturile financiare trimestriale ale sectorului institutional Administratii publice (S.13) - Trimestrul II 2024

confirmed_semantics.reporting_sector: S13 general government and its subsectors S1311, S1313, S1314
confirmed_semantics.consolidation: consolidated within and across the reported general-government subsectors

frozen_rmd_boundary_comparison.required_consolidation: non-consolidated sector/counterpart positions and transactions compatible with the RMD reference boundary

decisive_limits: The publication covers only S13 and its general-government subsectors; it does not expose the full RMD sector set H/C/F/G/BNR/X.
The published quarterly S13 series are consolidated, while the frozen RMD sectoral-position boundary requires non-consolidated sector/counterpart positions and transactions.
The indexed publication describes claims and liabilities by financial instrument and sequence-of-account category, not a complete quarterly who-to-whom matrix across the required RMD sectors.
Therefore the source cannot identify S121 central bank, the non-central-bank financial sector F, households/NPISH, NFCs and rest-of-world counterpart structure simultaneously on the frozen boundary.
non_reopen_conditions: Use S13-only quarterly accounts as if they represented all required RMD sectors.
Treat consolidated S13 data as non-consolidated sector/counterpart positions.
Infer missing counterpart sectors from instrument totals.
Combine the S13 publication with unrelated marginal sector series through residual allocation.
Relax the frozen full-sector counterpart boundary because this national quarterly source has a long history.

reopen_value.future_value: The source is useful as an official national S13 quarterly control and semantic reference. It becomes relevant to reopening only if BNR exposes an expanded quarterly non-consolidated counterpart dataset covering the full RMD sector and F2-F8 stock/transaction boundary.
